description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd
When Twilight Shepherd dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Twilight Shepherd enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Twilight Shepherd
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
